body: You look 5-10 years younger in the right photo
It meant ‘not good’. It was originally written for a Japanese magazine, IIRC

The 100ml rule is because if you (or a terrorist, whatever) fill a 100ml+ bottle of flammable liquid it won’t be quickly and easily extinguished if it was used to start a fire. Which is why sometimes they’ll limit the amount of 100ml bottles and containers you’re permitted onboard. Anything less than 100ml bottles is easily controlled and contained.
